scientific_integrity: Fully specified finite face-poset and gradient certificate, with an independent matching-polynomial count and independent edge-orbit character computation. Reproducible using standard Python 3; no external mathematical validation performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact homotopy and rational symmetry decomposition apply only to the ordinary matching complex of C3 Cartesian P5. No infinite-strip theorem, perfect-matching result, or integral symmetry splitting is asserted.
